title: Race2Hermanus Triathlon 2027
summary: Race2Hermanus, part of the SA Triathlon Series, on Sunday 2 May 2027 in Hermanus, with Ultra, Standard and Sprint distances.
description: Ultra: swim 2km, bike 80km, run 17km. Standard: swim 1.5km, bike 40km, run 11km. Sprint: swim 750m, bike 20km, run 5km. Solo, team and aquabike entries. Early bird until 31 Jan 2027, normal entry 1 Feb - 3 Apr 2027, late entry 4 - 25 Apr 2027. Entries are not yet open for R2H 2027.
profile: Race2Hermanus is a triathlon in Hermanus on Sunday 2 May 2027, part of the SA Triathlon Series. Athletes choose an Ultra, Standard or Sprint distance, solo or in teams, with a sea swim, a bike leg and a run. Entries open later and cost from R990 to R3 075, so it suits triathletes from first-timers on the sprint to experienced endurance racers.
